Dialogs in normal flow and inside an example modal

dialogsFade is still supported across the classic dialog modules. For editors inside a modal, dialogsInBody remains the safer configuration because the dialog markup is attached to the page body.

This mirrored page keeps the original example flow and loads the compiled /dist/summernote-classic.css and /dist/summernote-classic.js bundles.

Inline editor with faded dialogs

Use the link, image, or video buttons to see the fade effect.

Open the link dialog here and notice the dialog fade transition.

Editor inside a modal

This modal initializes Summernote with dialogsInBody: true.

Summernote inside an example modal

Use the toolbar to open a dialog from inside the modal.

Example configuration - Dialogs
summernote.create('#dialogs-fade-editor', {
  height: 240,
  dialogsFade: true,
  toolbar: [
    ['insert', ['link', 'picture', 'video']],
    ['view', ['codeview']],
  ],
});
summernote.create('#modal-editor', {
  height: 240,
  dialogsInBody: true,
  dialogsFade: true,
  toolbar: [
    ['insert', ['link', 'picture', 'video']],
    ['view', ['codeview']],
  ],
});
